description: Real Colab (A100) result for task #8 (optional, Timon round-9: 'if you wish you can also test 10^-6 or 10^-7 and report the difference'). torch-fem re-run at N=401 and N=1401 with tol=1e-6 and 1e-7; tol=1e-8 numbers reused from the already-committed torchfem_convergence_vs_fine_reference_full.json (same N, same run).
conclusion: L2 relative error identical to 4 significant digits across all three tolerances at both N. Wall-clock differs by only 1.02x (N=401) and 1.10x (N=1401) between tightest and loosest tolerance -- smaller than typical run-to-run GPU noise. 1e-8 costs essentially nothing extra; kept as the standard tolerance throughout the report.
